title: A single finite-presentation chart and its stage and limit tensor spectra
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transitions [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and $c$ a limiting cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\in I$, schemes $X_0,Y_0$ over $D(i_0)$, and a locally finitely presented morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ over that base [def-pc-fibre-product, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Write $g_0:Y_0\to D(i_0)$ for the structure map. Fix affine opens $W_0\subset D(i_0)$, $V_0\subset Y_0$, $U_0\subset X_0$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points], with $V_0\subset g_0^{-1}(W_0)$ and $U_0\subset f_0^{-1}(V_0)$. Put $J=\{i\in I:i_0\le i\}$ and $j_0=(i_0,\mathrm{refl})$. There exists a chart $a$ over $(J,j_0)$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-descent-chart]. For each $j\in J$, put $q=D(j\to i_0)$, let $f_q$ be the base change of $f_0$, and let $R=a.\mathrm{rings}(j)$ with its $a.\mathrm{rings}(j_0)$-algebra structure induced by the transition. There exist opens $V$ in the pulled-back target and $U$ in the pulled-back source, with $U\subset f_q^{-1}(V)$, such that $U=p_X^{-1}(U_0)$ and the restricted arrow $f_q|_U:U\to V$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_R\otimes a.\mathrm{map})$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. For $q=c.\pi(i_0)$ and $R=\operatorname{colim}a.\mathrm{rings}$, equipped with the coprojection algebra structure, such opens and an arrow isomorphism also exist; no source-open equality is required for this last clause. No flatness hypothesis or conclusion and no compactness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use exists_affineOpen_directedRingSystem for W₀, obtaining the ring diagram F, initial spectrum isomorphism e₀, every compatible stage presentation and the compatible colimit presentation.

Let f=f₀.resLE V₀ U₀ and q=(g₀.resLE W₀ V₀)≫e₀.hom. Construct B=Γ(V₀.toScheme,⊤), C=Γ(U₀.toScheme,⊤), aB=((ΓSpecIso R).inv≫q.appTop).hom, aC=f.appTop.hom.comp aB, and φ=f.appTop with the resulting R-algebra structures. φ is an algebra map by reflexivity. Local finite presentation is preserved by restriction, so finitePresentation_appLE at the two top affine opens gives φ.toRingHom.FinitePresentation. The isoSpec naturality and the Γ-Spec triangle identity give the compatible spectrum models.

Build a from the actual rings, algebras and φ. Apply affine_triple_tensor_base_change at each stage with its ring transition algebra and spectrum presentation. Apply it at the limit with the coprojection algebra and the colimit spectrum presentation, discarding only the unneeded source-open equality there.

theorem exists_flat_descent_chart_comparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left]
    (W₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Opens) (V₀ : Y₀.left.Opens) (U₀ : X₀.left.Opens)
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W₀) (hV : IsAffineOpen V₀) (hU : IsAffineOpen U₀)
    (hVW : V₀ ≤ Y₀.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W₀) (hUV : U₀ ≤ f₀.left ⁻¹ᵁ V₀) :
    ∃ a : FlatDescentChart {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩,
      letI := a.sourceAlgebra
      letI := a.targetAlgebra
      (∀ j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i},
        let q := D.map (homOfLE j.property).op
        let F := ((Over.pullback q).map f₀).left
        let R := a.rings.obj j
        letI := (a.rings.map (homOfLE (show (⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩ : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) ≤ j
          from j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ (V : ((Over.pullback q).obj Y₀).left.Opens)
          (U : ((Over.pullback q).obj X₀).left.Opens) (h : U ≤ F ⁻¹ᵁ V),
          U = (pullback.fst X₀.hom q) ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ ∧
          Nonempty (Arrow.mk (F.resLE V U h) ≅
            Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId R R) a.map).toRingHom)))) ∧
      (let q := c.π.app (op i₀)
        let F := ((Over.pullback q).map f₀).left
        let R := colimit a.rings
        letI := (colimit.ι a.rings ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩).hom.toAlgebra
        ∃ (V : ((Over.pullback q).obj Y₀).left.Opens)
          (U : ((Over.pullback q).obj X₀).left.Opens) (h : U ≤ F ⁻¹ᵁ V),
          Nonempty (Arrow.mk (F.resLE V U h) ≅
            Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId R R) a.map).toRingHom))))
